items.claim: Anthony Wint just fought on the Contender Series 10 to 12 days prior to this fight.
items.quote: Anthony Winfield fighting at the Contender Series 10 days ago, 11 days ago at fight Right now it's 8 days, but by fight time it'll be 10, 11, 12 days. I mean, he just fought.

items.claim: Anthony Wint has an undefeated record of 7-0.
items.quote: Anthony Wint is now 7-0 with a win at the Contender Series in 34 seconds.

items.claim: Terrance Chapman has a record of 5 wins and 1 loss with four of those wins coming by knockout.
items.quote: Terrance Chapman, right? Uh five wins, one loss. So, recently and four of those five are by KO.

items.claim: Anthony Wint defeated Matt Adams in 34 seconds landing 13 significant strikes to zero on the Contender Series.
items.quote: Anthony Wint is now 7-0 with a win at the Contender Series in 34 seconds. 13 significant strikes to zero. Got Matt Adams out of there quickly.

items.claim: Anthony Wint will win the fight against Terrance Chapman by first-round knockout.
items.quote: I think Anthony Wint wins by first round KO.
